Good to know

How do I book a session?

Message us on WhatsApp with your date, venue and the type of shoot. We'll confirm availability.

What packages do you offer?

Wedding packages, lobola packages, a combined lobola and wedding package at $450, and events coverage. Message us for details on each.

Do you photograph graduations and portraits?

Yes. We do studio, outdoor and evening sessions, including graduation shoots with your cap, gown and stole.

Can you cover my event?

Yes. Our events coverage includes pageants, stage events and birthdays. Tell us about your event on WhatsApp.

What currency are prices in?

US dollars, as listed in our catalogue. Ask us to confirm before you book.

Book your session

Available for bookings. Message us your date and we'll take it from there.
